ruling_text.rename-equivalent-electron: rename; the definition stays because the source data is in equivalent electrons, and the name is regenerated to say so
ruling_text.name-gains-operator: the name gains the omitted average, integral, weighting or normalisation where the DD source is the averaged or weighted quantity; the definition is rewritten only where the source is local
ruling_text.generic-name-single-object: sn edit with the seat's phrase as the reason and its proposed spelling as a hint only; pipeline and review settle the spelling and may decline
ruling_text.parent-family-definition: regenerate the definition to state one quantity where one exists; otherwise the name is held from the cut
ruling_text.species-wording: rewrite the definition to the catalog's one stored species population wording: a bare species density counts ions summed over all charge states, neutral atoms excluded
ruling_text.operator-wording: rewrite the definition to the catalog's one stored wording for the flux-surface average operator
